svg.title: NBO architecture and phased rollout split by layer
svg.desc: Top section: the four-layer NBO architecture with per-layer colors (propensity purple, sequence teal, timing coral, value amber) and a dashed pink phase 2 enrichment branch where free-form text flows through a semantic encoder, splitting into pooled embeddings for propensity (solid) and temporal embeddings for sequence (dashed, gated by an inline "if dense" pill). Bottom section: a per-layer rollout grid where each layer has its own column showing MVP requirements, optimal additions, and phase 2 changes specific to that layer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me the feature engineering code for the pooled embedding into propensity')
sendPrompt('Show me the code for temporal text embeddings into the sequence layer with per-customer density gating')
sendPrompt('Explain the timing layer in an NBO framework')
sendPrompt('Explain the value layer in an NBO framework')

g.text: Composite score combines all four layers
